preheader: SpaceX inks $120B Anthropic pact, Walmart raises guidance, and Anteaters battle Stanford.

lead.headline: SpaceX Inks $120.5B Deal with Anthropic
lead.body: Anthropic's regulatory S-1 filing revealed a massive agreement with SpaceX worth up to $120.5 billion. The deal pays SpaceX roughly $3.1 billion per month as Claude's developer scales operations. This partnership pairs Elon Musk's space company with an AI lab he previously criticized.
lead.why: For venture capital and tech strategy classes, this shows how leading AI labs are spending huge capital reserves on computing and satellite infrastructure.

stories.headline: Walmart Lifts Outlook Again on Broad Customer Gains
stories.body: Walmart beat third-quarter expectations and raised its full-year financial outlook for the third consecutive time. The company drew shoppers across all income brackets looking to cut costs amid elevated grocery and consumer prices.

sources.name: ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos

stories.why: In retail consulting and corporate finance, Walmart proves that value-oriented scale and pricing power can drive growth through changing macro environments.

stories.headline: Goldman Sachs Bullish on India with Overweight Upgrade
stories.body: Goldman Sachs upgraded Indian equities to Overweight, setting a December 2027 Nifty target of 28,500. Foreign portfolio investors channeled a record 84,291 crore rupees into the market during the first half of November, led by financials and autos.
stories.why: Emerging market equities are central to portfolio diversification, and India's inflows highlight where institutional fund managers see long-term corporate earnings growth.

stories.headline: EU Battling Month-Long Cyberattack Driven by AI
stories.body: A cyberattack executed using artificial intelligence struck a major European Union institution in October. EU cybersecurity officials confirmed that several digital tools remain offline nearly a month later as investigations continue.
stories.why: Cyber risk advisory is one of the fastest-growing niches in management consulting, and automated exploits create urgent demand for enterprise defense audits.

stories.headline: Pebble Introduces Index 01 Single-Button Smart Ring
stories.body: Hardware brand Pebble unveiled Index 01, a stainless steel ring with a single rubber-covered physical button. The low-tech wearable is built for quick AI voice inputs without complicated sensors or screens.
stories.why: For startup building, this is a clean case study in unbundling complex hardware into a focused, low-cost product that solves one task well.

stories.headline: Cognizant India Chief Says AI Will Reshape, Not Kill, Junior Roles
stories.body: Cognizant India chairman Rajesh Varrier stated that entry-level positions are not disappearing, but rather evolving to demand new technical skills. He pointed to a 2026 workforce study showing that fresh graduates who leverage AI tools effectively remain in strong demand.
stories.why: When interviewing for internships, emphasize your ability to use AI for market research and data analysis rather than worrying about automation replacing entry-level analysts.

stories.headline: AI Legal Lab Darrow Ranks on Deloitte Fast 500
stories.body: Legal intelligence lab Darrow placed 271st on the 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500 list. The ranking tracks rapid revenue growth among software firms that detect legal liability and regulatory exposure across industries.
stories.why: Deloitte's annual list serves as a practical recruiting target list for high-growth tech firms that need business analysts and operational talent.

stories.headline: Anteaters Suffer First Loss in Tight Battle at Stanford
stories.body: The UC Irvine men's basketball team fell to 3-1 after a 65-61 road defeat against Stanford. The Anteaters led for the bulk of the night before the Cardinal closed the game on an 8-0 scoring run over the final 2:33.

stories.headline: Jannik Sinner Seeking US Medical Opinion as Knee Concerns Mount
stories.body: Five-time Grand Slam champion Jannik Sinner is consulting specialists in the United States regarding a persistent knee injury. Potential surgery leaves his participation in the upcoming Australian Open in jeopardy.

term.name: Overweight
term.definition: An investment rating indicating that an analyst expects an asset, sector, or country market to outperform its peers or benchmark index. Institutional portfolios following this guidance allocate a higher percentage of capital to that holding.

serve.headline: Disseqt AI raised $8M to verify enterprise AI agents
serve.body: Dublin startup Disseqt AI secured $8 million in funding led by Gresham House Ventures to build safety and compliance monitoring systems for autonomous enterprise agents. The round attracted angel capital from cricket star Rahul Dravid as well as executives from OpenAI, Meta, and Salesforce.
